check_task_parameters: check if InferenceClient task methods have missing or outdated parameters and report mismatches
update_task_parameters: update InferenceClient source code to add missing parameters and fix outdated types and docstrings
check_method_parameters: check a specific InferenceClient method for missing or outdated parameters against its dataclass definition
update_method_docstring: update a method's docstring to add or fix parameter descriptions in the Args section
add_method_imports: add missing import statements to the InferenceClient module for new parameter types
